variants.asks: the vacuum equation has one term that is not a rule. Write a hydrogen state into it and nothing else - how much of the equation has to change, and what do n, l and m turn out to be counts of?

probes.asks: a hydrogen state is a choice of source term in the vacuum equation. Count what that choice actually carries - and count how many terms of the equation it touches
probes.found: n - l - 1 radial sign changes on 7/7 states, l - |m| polar zeros on 7/7, 2|m| azimuthal on 7/7 - and 1 term of the equation depends on the state

measured.name: \nu_{r}
measured.note: the radial schedule's sign changes, counted off the actual associated Laguerre for each state: 1s: 0 (n-l-1 = 0), 2s: 1 (n-l-1 = 1), 2p_z: 0 (n-l-1 = 0), 3d_z2: 0 (n-l-1 = 0), 3d_xy: 0 (n-l-1 = 0), 4d_z2: 1 (n-l-1 = 1), 4f_z3: 0 (n-l-1 = 0). Path length is time, so a sign change at tick t is a node at radius t - which is the whole of what n does here, and it is emitted rather than derived

measured.name: \nu_{\theta}
measured.note: and the pattern's zeros in the polar angle come to l - |m| on 7 of 7 states - the lobes up the axis, which is what separates 2p from 3d at the same m

measured.name: \nu_{\phi}
measured.note: and 2|m| round the azimuth on 7 of 7 - the fold, which is what separates 3d_z2 from 3d_xy at the same l

measured.name: \Sigma_{nlm}
measured.note: what the source PUTS OUT, meaned over the sphere and over a whole period: 7.43e-1 per tick per unit rate, averaged over the seven states, and positive for every one of them. Counting the zeros of R_nl and |Y_lm|^2 says nothing about whether either is ever anything else, so this is the measurement that makes the product a product of something. IT IS ALSO WHY 3d AND 4d CANNOT BE COMPARED BY BRIGHTNESS - gating the firing on |R_nl| makes 3d emit 0.39 times what 4d does over a period - NOT the 280 the dumped fields differ by, and not the "three hundred" this file used to say. The ballistic twins differ by 1.08, so the two sources put out the same amount and the gap is entirely what the vacuum did with it

measured.name: T_{state}
measured.note: AND THE NUMBER OF TERMS IN THE EQUATION THAT KNOW WHICH STATE IS BEING RUN IS ONE. n, l and m reach the model through `source.pattern` and `source.schedule` and through nothing else; sigma, tau, nu, stir, shine, makes and THETA are the same numbers for every state. measured.name: \Sigma/(\Sigma_{\theta}\Sigma_{t})
measured.note: the joint acceptance against the product of its own margins, meaned over the cells where both margins carry something: 1s 1.000, 2s 1.000, 2p_z 1.000, 3d_z2 1.009, 3d_xy 0.995, 4d_z2 1.004, 4f_z3 0.998 - 1.001 over the seven, on 200000 draws a state through the same two gates `lib/Vacuum.ts` fires through.
